clauses.note: Current-source physical L7→L8 routes complete at both tiers with no skips or console/page errors. Personally inspected all75 frames: low one follower and high four followers arrive by the bus with green bars and courier/corgi. Native production reconstruction from actual physical L7 results confirms exact IDs at maxHP (high health60 is max60), corgi100/100, exact LEFT/RIGHT racks and selected rocket launcher; independent read-only controls match. Archived live ledgers/logs compare the actual human IDs/HP, racks and selection across entry, while native complete receipts census zero weapon pickups. All11 semantic fault controls reject. The proof harness had assumed an old empty-low-roster run; current evidence has one legal low survivor, so that seed-specific assertion now accepts the unchanged0–35 criterion. No game or receipt-consumer target changed.
